name: Greed IF
divergenceSummary: Subaru accepts Echidna's contract at the Witch's Tea Party, abandoning his faith in natural outcomes to rely on Return by Death as a computational engine, dying over one hundred million times.
headline: The Contract of Millions of Deaths
description: Subaru accepts Echidna's contract at the Witch's Tea Party. Dying over 100 million times to optimize every event, his emotional soul slowly withers away.

events.name: The Signing of the Witch's Contract
events.description: Subaru agrees to Echidna's terms, gaining access to her boundless wisdom while allowing her to treat his lives as infinite experiment trials.

events.name: One Hundred Million Calculated Deaths
events.description: Subaru commits suicide for the most trivial variables—the weather, a stumble, a casual remark—racking up over 100 million agonizing deaths to craft a 'flawless' timeline.

events.name: The Hollow Puppet of Perfect Outcomes
events.description: Though all his friends survive unharmed and smiling, Subaru's soul is completely dead inside, incapable of feeling warmth, sorrow, or personal attachment.
